pages.patch:
--- a/src/content/docs/product/product-facts.mdx
+++ b/src/content/docs/product/product-facts.mdx
@@ -75,7 +75,7 @@
 - The web demo is a technology demo, not the product. It is being hardened right now: website references to it were disabled August 11 until it moves onto monitored infrastructure, and its progress display can stall silently even when an analysis succeeded. Each feature has its own built-in usage limit; it is not a "5 free scans" model, so do not quote a number.
 - Enterprise and federal editions are not yet self-serve: the software works, but there is no published way for a customer to download it; today each customer is granted access individually.
 - The hosted platform is not yet SOC-2 or FedRAMP certified; the on-premises and air-gapped editions are how federal requirements are met today.
-- Portfolios as a concept are in development, not early access: scoring, data health, and the portfolio pages appear only on projects where they have been enabled for iteration, and none of it has an announced date. Everything lives within a project; there is no cross-project rollup, by design.
+- Portfolios as a concept are in development, not early access: scoring, data health, and the portfolio pages appear on every project, and none of it has an announced date. Everything lives within a project; there is no cross-project rollup, by design.
 - Pricing and packaging are not finalized; do not quote numbers.
 - Registry-scanning coverage by registry type (Artifactory, Nexus, others) varies; engineering can confirm any specific type.
 - The demo/sample projects change; the [Demo Guide](/docs/product/demo-guide/) target list is the source of truth for which to use (currently: sample-apps).
